description: Read the weekly report of a site: what changed since last week, the new pages of up to 3 competitors and every finding. Reading never runs the report. Once a week the report checks the first 500 URLs of the site's sitemap, says what changed since the week before (new and fixed problems, new pages) and lists the new pages of up to 3 competitor sitemaps. It comes with the watch packages: one site for every 25 paid pages. Reading never runs the report.

lang.description: optional: pt for the texts in Portuguese
